overload_sim.configuration.simulation.to: Processing, FE storage and output settings for the ordinary simulation chamber.
overload_sim.configuration.multiblock.to: Processing, crystal and output settings for the multiblock simulation chamber.
overload_sim.configuration.coil.tooltip: Charging, lightning strike and mining settings for the resonance coil.
overload_sim.configuration.tesla.tooltip: Settings for the Transcendent Crystal recipe added by this addon.
overload_sim.configuration.workstation.t: Processing, item, fluid and output settings for the High Energy Workstation.
overload_sim.configuration.laser.tooltip: Beam energy, travel distance, enhancement and damage settings.
overload_sim.configuration.core.tooltip: Activation requirements for particle production in the collapse core.
overload_sim.configuration.receiver.tool: FE and particle storage capacities of the particle receiver.
overload_sim.configuration.explosion.too: Spherical explosion settings for the receiver. The enable switch is in a separate configuration section.
overload_sim.configuration.simulation.en: FE capacity of the ordinary simulation chamber. Lowering it retains stored FE and blocks further intake while over capacity. Range: 1–2,147,483,647 FE. Default: 2,000,000 FE. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.simulation.re: Maximum FE accepted per energy capability call. Zero disables intake. Range: 0–2,147,483,647 FE. Default: 2,000,000 FE. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.simulation.ma: Maximum operations per simulation batch. Lowering it does not remove installed upgrades. Range: 1–256 operations. Default: 128 operations. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.simulation.pa: Parallel operations provided by each Lightning Collapse Matrix, subject to the maximum batch parallelism. Range: 1–256 operations. Default: 4 operations. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.simulation.st: Interval between checks for starting a simulation batch. 20 ticks = 1 second. Range: 1–400 tick. Default: 10 tick. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.simulation.ej: Maximum items transferred per automatic output cycle. Zero disables automatic output. Range: 0–2,147,483,647 items. Default: 64 items. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.simulation.ti: Percentage of the original recipe duration. 100% retains the original duration. Applies to new batches. Range: 1–20,000 %. Default: 100 %. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.simulation.en: Percentage of the original recipe FE cost. 100% retains the original cost. Applies to new batches. Range: 0–20,000 %. Default: 100 %. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.simulation.li: Percentage of the original recipe lightning cost. 100% retains the original cost. Applies to new batches. Range: 0–20,000 %. Default: 100 %. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.multiblock.en: FE capacity of the multiblock simulation chamber. Lowering it retains stored FE and blocks further intake while over capacity. Range: 1–2,147,483,647 FE. Default: 2,000,000 FE. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.multiblock.re: Maximum FE accepted per energy capability call. Zero disables intake. Range: 0–2,147,483,647 FE. Default: 2,000,000 FE. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.multiblock.ne: Maximum FE drawn per tick from Applied Flux storage on the ME network. Zero disables withdrawals. Range: 0–2,147,483,647 FE/tick. Default: 10,000 FE/tick. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.multiblock.ma: Maximum simulation crystals participating in a new batch. Lowering it retains stored crystals. Range: 1–49 crystals. Default: 49 crystals. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.multiblock.ou: Item limit of each bulk output slot. Lowering it retains stored items and blocks additions while over capacity. Range: 1–2,147,483,647 items. Default: 1,024 items. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.multiblock.ex: Interval between automatic export attempts. 20 ticks = 1 second. Range: 1–400 tick. Default: 5 tick. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.multiblock.ti: Percentage of the original recipe duration. 100% retains the original duration. Applies to new batches. Range: 1–20,000 %. Default: 100 %. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.multiblock.en: Percentage of the original recipe FE cost. 100% retains the original cost. Applies to new batches. Range: 0–20,000 %. Default: 100 %. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.multiblock.li: Percentage of the original recipe lightning cost. 100% retains the original cost. Applies to new batches. Range: 0–20,000 %. Default: 100 %. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.coil.baseCapa: FE capacity of the resonance coil before capacity modules. Lowering it retains stored FE. Range: 1–40,000,000,000 FE. Default: 10,000,000 FE. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.coil.capacity: Maximum FE capacity after installing capacity modules. Lowering it retains stored FE and blocks charging while over capacity. Range: 1–40,000,000,000 FE. Default: 20,000,000,000 FE. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.coil.lightnin: Amount of lightning energy at the selected voltage consumed per strike. Range: 1–2,000,000 units. Default: 10 units. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.coil.efficien: Maximum efficiency level used for mining speed. Lowering it retains installed items. Range: 0–10 levels. Default: 10 levels. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.coil.fortuneL: Maximum fortune level used for drops. Lowering it retains installed items. Range: 0–5 levels. Default: 5 levels. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.coil.baseMini: Base mining speed before efficiency bonuses. Range: 0.1–2,000. Default: 9. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.tesla.crystal: FE consumed by the addon Tesla recipe per Transcendent Crystal. The prerequisite's five-tick processing time remains fixed. Range: 5–16,000,000 FE. Default: 500,000 FE. Reenter the world to apply.
Extreme voltage lightning energy produced per Transcendent Crystal. A running batch retains its output captured at start. Range: 1–2,000,000 units. Default: 64 units. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.workstation.l: Incoming laser energy per 20-tick batch must be strictly greater than this value for the workstation to process. Range: 0–1,000,000,000,000,000 FE/20 tick. Default: 1,000,000,000 FE/20 tick. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.workstation.m: Maximum recipe operations per workstation batch. Range: 1–2,097,152 operations. Default: 1,024 operations. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.workstation.c: Ticks required to complete a successful batch. 20 ticks = 1 second. Range: 1–144,000 tick. Default: 2 tick. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.workstation.s: Item limit of each input or output slot. Lowering it retains stored items and blocks additions while over capacity. Range: 1–2,147,483,647 items. Default: 1,000,000 items. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.workstation.t: Capacity of each fluid tank. Lowering it retains stored fluid and blocks filling while over capacity. Range: 1–2,147,483,647 mB. Default: 1,024,000,000 mB. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.workstation.i: Total items automatically exported per tick. The ME network and adjacent containers share this budget. Zero disables export. Range: 0–2,147,483,647 items/tick. Default: 2,147,483,647 items/tick. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.workstation.f: Total fluid automatically exported per tick. The ME network and adjacent containers share this budget. Zero disables export. Range: 0–2,147,483,647 mB/tick. Default: 2,147,483,647 mB/tick. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.laser.maxBeam: Beam FE limit per 20-tick batch. An over-limit source emits nothing and pays nothing. An over-limit downstream modifier pays no modifier cost; upstream emitted costs remain paid. Range: 1–1,000,000,000,000,000 FE/20 tick. Default: 1,000,000,000,000,000 FE/20 tick. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.laser.energyC: FE capacity of laser emitters and matrices. Lowering it retains stored FE and blocks intake while over capacity. Range: 1–2,048,000,000,000,000,000 FE. Default: 1,000,000,000 FE. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.laser.emitter: Maximum beam travel distance after leaving an emitter. Range: 1–64 blocks. Default: 6 blocks. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.laser.constra: Maximum beam travel distance after leaving a constraint matrix. Range: 1–64 blocks. Default: 6 blocks. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.laser.deflect: Maximum beam travel distance after leaving a deflector. Range: 1–64 blocks. Default: 6 blocks. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.laser.boostMi: Minimum selectable enhancement FE. If set above the maximum, the effective minimum equals the maximum. Range: 1–2,000,000,000 FE. Default: 100,000 FE. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.laser.boostMa: Maximum selectable enhancement FE. Range: 1–2,000,000,000 FE. Default: 9,000,000 FE. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.laser.boostSt: FE adjustment per enhancement slider step. The effective step is limited by the selectable span and uses 1 FE when the span is zero. Range: 1–2,000,000,000 FE. Default: 100,000 FE. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.laser.burstMu: Beam energy multiplier applied by each burst matrix. Range: 1–128 ×. Default: 2 ×. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.laser.damageI: Interval between beam entity damage checks. 20 ticks = 1 second. Range: 1–400 tick. Default: 2 tick. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.laser.maxDama: Maximum damage per beam hit. Two damage points equal one heart. Range: 0–2,000,000 damage points. Default: 1,000,000 damage points. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.core.activati: Incoming laser energy per 20-tick batch must reach this value for particle production. Particle conversion costs remain fixed. Range: 1–1,000,000,000,000,000 FE/20 tick. Default: 1,000,000,000 FE/20 tick. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.receiver.ener: FE output storage capacity of the particle receiver. Lowering it retains stored FE. Range: 1–2,048,000,000,000,000,000 FE. Default: 1,024,000,000,000,000,000 FE. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.receiver.part: Particle storage limit of the receiver. Lowering it retains stored particles and does not itself trigger an explosion. Range: 1–2,000,000,000 particles. Default: 125,000 particles. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.explosion.rad: Explosion radius around the receiver optical center, affecting loaded chunks only. The enable switch is under Laser Costs and Explosions. Range: 1–64 blocks. Default: 12 blocks. Reenter the world to apply.
overload_sim.configuration.simulation.ma: Lightning Collapse Matrices allowed in the ordinary simulation chamber. Range: 1–32. Default: 32. Lowering it retains installed matrices and limits the effective count. Valid changes apply immediately.
overload_sim.configuration.simulation.ac: AE2 acceleration cards allowed in the ordinary simulation chamber. Range: 0–4. Default: 4. Lowering it retains installed cards and limits the effective count. Valid changes apply immediately.
overload_sim.configuration.simulation.au: Automatic export interval of the ordinary simulation chamber. Range: 1–400 ticks. Default: 10 ticks. 20 ticks = 1 second. Valid changes apply immediately.
overload_sim.configuration.simulation.ne: Simulation Chamber ME FE Draw per Tick

Maximum FE drawn per tick from Applied Flux storage on an active ME network, including while idle. Range: 0–4,000,000 FE/tick. Default: 10,000 FE/tick. Zero disables withdrawals. Valid changes apply immediately.
overload_sim.configuration.coil.lightnin: Lightning strike range of the resonance coil. Range: 1–256 blocks. Default: 32 blocks. Valid changes apply immediately.
overload_sim.configuration.coil.selfStri: Charge time before a resonance coil self-strike. Range: 1–400 ticks. Default: 30 ticks. 20 ticks = 1 second. Valid changes apply immediately.
overload_sim.configuration.coil.lightnin: Cooldown between resonance coil strikes. Range: 1–400 ticks. Default: 10 ticks. 20 ticks = 1 second. Valid changes apply immediately.
overload_sim.configuration.coil.miningEn: FE consumed per mined block or melee hit. Strikes separately consume lightning energy at the selected voltage. Range: 0–2,000,000 FE. Default: 200 FE. Valid changes apply immediately.
overload_sim.configuration.coil.chargeFe: Maximum FE charged to the resonance coil per tick. Range: 0–2,000,000 FE/tick. Default: 10,000 FE/tick. Zero disables charging. Valid changes apply immediately.
overload_sim.configuration.laser.emitter: FE consumed and emitted by the emitter per actual 20-tick beam batch. Range: 1–1,000,000,000,000,000 FE/batch. Default: 100,000 FE/batch. Valid changes apply immediately.
overload_sim.configuration.laser.constra: Constraint Matrix FE Cost per Batch
FE consumed by each constraint matrix per actual 20-tick beam batch. Range: 0–2,000,000,000 FE/batch. Default: 100,000 FE/batch. Valid changes apply immediately.
overload_sim.configuration.laser.burstEx: Extreme voltage lightning energy consumed by each burst matrix per actual 20-tick beam batch. Range: 0–2,000,000,000 units/batch. Default: 64 units/batch. Valid changes apply immediately.
overload_sim.configuration.laser.laserDa: Beam damage multiplier, subject to the per-hit limit in Machine Values and Capacities. Range: 0–200×. Default: 1×. Zero disables beam damage. Valid changes apply immediately.
overload_sim.configuration.explosion.exp: Allows charged receivers to explode on particle overflow or broken containment. Turning it off disables block destruction, entity damage, explosion sound and animation. Default: On. Valid changes apply immediately.

Retained for existing configuration compatibility and ignored by current explosions. Legacy range: 1–64 blocks. Legacy default: 12 blocks. The spherical radius is controlled under Machine Values and Capacities → Receiver Explosions.

Maximum blocks processed per tick during an explosion. A smaller budget spreads the explosion over more ticks. Range: 64–8,192 blocks/tick. Default: 1,024 blocks/tick. Valid changes apply immediately.

Default: enabled. Other dimensions do not compare coordinates. Unloaded targets pause until loaded again. Changes apply immediately.
